== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[R5-D4 (Arfive-Defour) (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]]. Compared with [[R5-D4 (Arfive-Defour) (PC Errata 2018 E card)]]. The whole earlier image and the whole new image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>58799a69735590c925fe5ad00507695e19ef7aab</code>.
